text:
ITEM 1 | Square white plate about 26 cm across; long golden-brown straight-cut fries/wedges with crisp fried edges and slightly oily sheen, about 10 fingers each roughly 8-10 cm long and 1.5 cm thick, piled loosely on the right side covering about 20% of the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Dark brown, crumbly-textured cooked meat patty or chunk with browned crust, about 4 x 3 cm, sitting among the fries on the right side, slightly glossy | 35
ITEM 3 | Pale pinkish-tan mixed mass of soft grains, possibly moist and clumping, with a slightly shiny surface and some pinkish pieces, about 5 x 4 cm and 1.5 cm high, sitting on the lower center-right of the plate | 45
ITEM 4 | Fresh dark green leafy greens with thin stems, flat broad leaves, matte and slightly wet, a small cluster about 6 x 4 cm lying beside the rice mass and under the fries | 8
ITEM 5 | Scattered small pale cream-colored crumbs or bits, a few pieces about 0.5 to 1 cm, dry and crumbly, located near the center-left of the plate | 2
